end.summary: Asha discussed Diwali, Pongal, Baisakhi, and Makar Sankranti.
end.parentNote: Asha practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready. Kavya first said festival dates were random and unrelated to farming; later, they said crops are celebrated when ready for harvest and placed Pongal in January, but the original mix-up was not fully resolved by the end. At home, ask Kavya to match one harvest festival with its crop season and explain the connection in one sentence.
